name: Selloway AI Chat for WooCommerce
author: Selloway

sections.description:
A shopper lands on your product page. They have one question — will this fit me? how long is delivery? is this the right size? — and there is nobody to ask.

So they leave. You never find out.

Selloway is the assistant that speaks first. Not a chat bubble sitting in the corner waiting to be clicked — an assistant that opens the conversation on the product page, answers in a couple of seconds, and walks the shopper to the Add to cart button.

See it the way your shopper does

  1. A visitor opens one of your products.
  2. A few seconds later a short, friendly message appears — written for that product, not a generic “How can I help?”
  3. They ask something. They get a real answer, in their own language, in about two seconds.
  4. They add to cart — instead of closing the tab.

Why this one is different

It speaks first. Most chat plugins wait. Waiting means only a small fraction of visitors ever ask anything, so most questions are never asked — they just turn into a lost sale.

It knows what it is selling. Answers come from your own product: its name, its price, its description, and the selling points you write. It is not a general chatbot repeating the same lines on every page.

Every product gets its own opening line. Write it yourself, or press one button and let the AI write it for you.

It is built to sell, not just to answer. It handles the questions that decide a purchase — “which one is right for me?”, “will this work for me?” — and nudges toward the cart.

What you get

  • A first message that appears on its own, unique to each product
  • Answers in about 2 seconds, day and night, in 80+ languages
  • Your own selling points and Add-to-cart message per product
  • A choice of tone: professional, friendly, casual or luxury
  • Colours, fonts, position and size you control — with a live preview
  • A gentle reminder for visitors who go quiet
  • A record of every conversation, so you can read what shoppers actually ask
  • A free Sales Audit that scores your store and tells you what to fix first

Set up in three steps

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Press Activate free. That is the whole account setup — no signup form, no key to copy.
  3. Press Sync products so the assistant learns your catalogue.

Done. Open one of your products in a new tab and watch it start talking.

Who this is for

WooCommerce owners who already have visitors but not enough orders — especially stores where people have a real question before they buy: clothing, electronics, supplements, coffee, cosmetics, home goods.

What it costs

There is a free plan, and it stays free. No card is needed to start. If your store outgrows it, you can upgrade for more conversations — and you can uninstall at any time.

External services

Selloway writes its replies using artificial intelligence, and that cannot run inside WordPress on your own hosting. So the plugin sends what it needs to the Selloway service (api.selloway.com), operated by Selloway, and shows you the answer that comes back.

This is the only outside service the plugin uses. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

Here is exactly what leaves your site, and when:

  • When you activate or connect your store (you press the button): your licence key, your site address, your admin email, and the version numbers of the plugin, WordPress and WooCommerce — so the service knows which store it is talking to.
  • When you sync products (you press the button): each product’s name, price, description and link, plus the greeting, selling points and Add-to-cart message you wrote — so the assistant can answer questions about that product.
  • When a visitor chats (the visitor types): what the visitor writes, which product page they are on, and an identifier for the conversation — so a reply can be generated and sent back.

Nothing is sent while a visitor is only browsing. Nothing is sent to any other company.

Service terms:

  • Terms of Service: https://selloway.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://selloway.com/privacy
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Selloway adds the assistant to WooCommerce product pages, so WooCommerce 3.0 or newer needs to be installed and active.

Do I need an OpenAI key or any technical setup?

No. There is nothing to configure and no key to buy. Install, press Activate free, and it works.

Will it slow my store down?

No. It loads only on product pages, and the rest of your store is untouched.

Can I write the first message myself?

Yes — or let the AI write it. Edit any product, scroll to the Selloway box, and either type your own greeting or press Generate with AI. You can mix both across your catalogue.

What if I do not like the answers it gives?

You are in control of what it knows. Add selling points to a product and the assistant will use them. Change the tone in Settings. Every conversation is saved, so you can read exactly what it said.

What languages does it speak?

Over 80. It can detect the visitor’s language on its own, or stick to the one you choose.

Can I change how it looks?

Yes. Colours, fonts, position, size and branding, all from Settings, with a live preview while you edit.

Is it a live chat or a chatbot?

For your shopper it feels like live chat — a real conversation on the page. Behind it is an AI that answers instantly, 24/7, without you sitting at a keyboard.

Where does the AI actually run?

On Selloway’s own servers. The plugin talks only to Selloway and to nothing else. The exact details are in the “External services” section below.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The assistant disappears from your store immediately. Nothing is left behind on your pages.
sections.changelog:
0.4.2

  • Turn the assistant on with a single Activate free button — no signup and no licence key to copy or paste.
  • Simpler connection screen: the manual key field is now optional and out of the way. Most stores never need it.

0.4.1

  • After activation you land straight on the free Sales Audit, so you see something useful before anything else.
  • A guided welcome banner with a one-click link to create your free account.

0.4.0

  • New: Sales Audit — scores your store’s sales health and lists what to fix first, in plain English, across engagement, product content, trust, merchandising, setup and SEO.
  • The audit points out where turning the assistant on will recover the most lost sales.

0.3.0

  • New name and look: Selloway AI Chat for WooCommerce.
  • A first message per product — written by you or generated with AI.
  • The “Powered by” badge is off unless you turn it on.
  • Removed the Custom CSS field; appearance is set through proper controls.
  • Documented the external Selloway service.

0.2.0

  • Appearance settings, language settings, live preview, plus security and stability fixes.

0.1.0

  • First release.
